summary: The argument is mathematically correct. The actual horizontal lattice count obeys N <= v <= 3N, the thickened body has the asserted centroid, and that centroid projects to an actual point of C_0. Grünbaum's centroid form is confirmed in Section 3 of the cited primary source and applies to the full-dimensional thickened body. Reflection of the original integer fibers supplies the factor 1/2 for every halfspace through the selected point, yielding the stated gamma_(d+1)/6 bound and the absolute constant. Singleton horizontal sections, integral radii, zero-volume fibers, zero normal components, and containing halfspaces introduce no gap.
